title: Kiran and the Paper Boat
title_alts: The Puddle That Moved On Its Own
refrain: Push it gently, let it go
description_hook: Kiran folds a paper boat and cannot make it sail. Then she notices something the puddle was doing all along.

characters.name: Kiran
characters.description: seven years old, short dark hair with a red clip, blue kurta rolled at the sleeves, bare feet

scenes.narration: Kiran crouched beside the wide monsoon puddle and set her paper boat down on the water. She wanted it to sail all the way to the gate. Push it gently, let it go.
scenes.caption: किरन ने बरसाती पानी में अपनी कागज़ की नाव रखी।
scenes.image_brief: Kiran, a seven-year-old girl in a blue kurta with a red hair clip, crouching barefoot beside a wide rain puddle on a village street, placing a small white paper boat on the water, bright light after rain

scenes.narration: She blew hard at the little folded sail. Blow with me, one big puff! The boat spun in a slow circle and tipped over sideways.
scenes.caption: उसने नाव पर ज़ोर से फूँक मारी, नाव उलट गई।
scenes.image_brief: Kiran leaning close to the puddle with her cheeks puffed, blowing at the paper boat, the boat tilted at an angle on the water, ripples spreading outward

scenes.narration: Water crept into the folded paper and turned one side soft and grey. Kiran's knees ached from crouching and her chest went tight.
scenes.caption: नाव में पानी भर गया और किरन का मन भारी हो गया।
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a soggy paper boat leaning in a puddle with one grey wet side, Kiran's knees and bare feet at the edge of the frame, overcast light

scenes.narration: Then Kiran noticed the water itself was moving, sliding slowly along the road towards the gate. Push it gently, let it go.
scenes.caption: तभी किरन ने देखा कि पानी खुद बह रहा था।
scenes.image_brief: Kiran sitting back on her heels watching a thin stream of rainwater running along the edge of the road towards a metal gate, her eyes wide with the idea

scenes.narration: She lifted the boat into that moving line of water and watched it glide past her feet, past the wall, all the way to the gate.
scenes.caption: उसने नाव उस बहती धार में रखी और वह गेट तक पहुँच गई।
scenes.image_brief: Kiran standing and watching her paper boat travelling along a narrow stream of rainwater beside a wall towards a metal gate, warm late afternoon light on the wet road

scenes.narration: Push it gently, let it go.
scenes.caption: धीरे से रखो, बहने दो।
scenes.image_brief: Kiran sitting on a low step with wet feet, smiling quietly at the far gate, soft evening light, the road still shining with rain

title: The Letter B and Three Round Things
title_alts: Buh, Buh, B - What Starts With B?
description_hook: One letter, three everyday things, and a sound to say out loud together.

characters.name: Bela
characters.description: four years old, two short plaits, orange t-shirt, sitting cross-legged

scenes.narration: Today Bela is learning one letter. It is the letter B. B says buh, buh, B.
scenes.caption: आज बेला एक अक्षर सीख रही है, अक्षर B।
scenes.image_brief: Bela, a four-year-old girl with two short plaits in an orange t-shirt, sitting cross-legged on a bedroom floor with a large wooden letter B in her lap, warm lamp light

scenes.narration: Look at the shape. A tall line, and two round bumps beside it. Tall line, two bumps. That is B.
scenes.caption: एक लंबी लकीर और दो गोल उभार, यही है B।
scenes.image_brief: A large wooden letter B standing upright on a bedroom floor, Bela's finger tracing the tall line and the two round bumps, soft shadow behind it

scenes.narration: Here is a ball. Ball starts with buh. B says buh, buh, B.
scenes.caption: यह गेंद है, गेंद में buh की आवाज़ है।
scenes.image_brief: A blue and white rubber ball resting on a bedroom floor beside the wooden letter B, Bela's hand reaching towards it

scenes.narration: Now you try. Put your lips together and say it with Bela. Buh!
scenes.caption: अब तुम कहो, होंठ मिलाकर, buh!
scenes.image_brief: Bela with her lips pressed together mid-sound, looking straight ahead, the wooden letter B beside her, bright even light

scenes.narration: B says buh, buh, B.
scenes.caption: B कहता है buh, buh, B।
scenes.image_brief: Bela clapping once with the wooden letter B in front of her on the bedroom floor, cheerful lamp light

scenes.narration: A banana in the fruit bowl. Buh. A button on her shirt. Buh. Banana, button, ball.
scenes.caption: केला, बटन, गेंद - सब में buh।
scenes.image_brief: A yellow banana in a fruit bowl and a round shirt button laid side by side on a bedroom floor next to a blue ball, daylight from a window

scenes.narration: Which one starts with buh? A bell, or a cat? A bell! Bell starts with buh.
scenes.caption: कौन buh से शुरू होता है, घंटी या बिल्ली? घंटी!
scenes.image_brief: A small brass bell on the left and a sleeping grey cat on the right of a bedroom floor, the letter B standing between them

scenes.narration: Ball, banana, button, bell. All buh. B says buh, buh, B.
scenes.caption: गेंद, केला, बटन, घंटी - सब buh। B कहता है buh, buh, B।
scenes.image_brief: A ball, a banana, a button and a small bell arranged in a row on a bedroom floor with the wooden letter B behind them, soft evening lamp light

title: Devi Gives Away the Last Guava
title_alts: Devi and the One Guava Left
The Guava Devi Did Not Eat
refrain: Sharing makes the sweet last longer
description_hook: There is one guava left on the tree and two people who want it. Devi finds a third answer.

characters.name: Devi
characters.description: eight years old, long braided hair with a green ribbon, yellow frock, a small scar on her elbow

characters.name: Nanu
characters.description: her three-year-old brother, round cheeks, striped shorts, always barefoot

scenes.narration: Devi spotted the very last guava high on the courtyard tree, and her mouth watered. She had been waiting all week for that one. Sharing makes the sweet last longer.
scenes.caption: देवी ने पेड़ पर आख़िरी अमरूद देखा और मुँह में पानी आ गया।
scenes.image_brief: Devi, an eight-year-old girl in a yellow frock with a braided ponytail and green ribbon, looking up at a single ripe guava high in a courtyard tree, morning light through the leaves

scenes.narration: She stretched onto her toes and shook the trunk with both arms. Leaves came down. The guava did not.
scenes.caption: उसने पंजों पर खड़े होकर पेड़ हिलाया, पत्ते गिरे, अमरूद नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: Devi on her tiptoes with both arms around a thin guava trunk, leaves falling around her shoulders, the fruit still high above

scenes.narration: Then Nanu came running, saw the guava, and began to cry with his arms up. Devi's stomach twisted.
scenes.caption: तभी नानू दौड़कर आया और अमरूद देखकर रोने लगा।
scenes.image_brief: Nanu, a three-year-old boy in striped shorts, standing barefoot in a courtyard with both arms raised and crying, Devi turning towards him under the guava tree

scenes.narration: Devi looked at the branch, and then at the low wall beside it. Can you see it? She could reach from there. Sharing makes the sweet last longer.
scenes.caption: देवी ने दीवार देखी - वहाँ से हाथ पहुँच जाएगा।
scenes.image_brief: Devi standing with one hand on a low courtyard wall looking up at the guava branch, thinking, Nanu behind her rubbing his eyes

scenes.narration: She climbed the wall, picked it, pressed her thumb along the seam until it opened, and gave Nanu the bigger half. Try it with me. It tasted better than a whole one.
scenes.caption: उसने अमरूद खोला और बड़ा हिस्सा नानू को दिया।
scenes.image_brief: Devi and Nanu sitting side by side on a courtyard step, each holding half a guava split along its seam, Nanu's half slightly larger, warm morning light on the stone

scenes.narration: Sharing makes the sweet last longer.
scenes.caption: बाँटने से मिठास और देर तक रहती है।
scenes.image_brief: Two guava halves resting on a courtyard step with two pairs of bare feet beside them, dappled light through the guava tree
